title: At the Doctor
text:
Ana feels sick today. She has a fever and a cough. Her mother calls the doctor. They go to the clinic at ten o'clock.

The doctor looks at Ana's throat. He says she needs rest and lots of water. He gives her medicine to help her get better. Ana says thank you and smiles.

questions.text: What time do Ana and her mother go to the clinic?
What does the doctor say Ana needs?
How does Ana probably feel at the end of the story?
Why does the doctor give Ana medicine?
options: To make her sleep at school

vocabulary.definition: a higher body temperature than normal when you are ill
a sound you make when you push air out of your throat because it is itchy or sore
a person who helps sick people and gives them medicine
a substance you take to help you get better when you are ill

paragraph_translations: Ana se sente doente hoje. Ela tem febre e tosse. A mãe dela liga para o médico. Elas vão à clínica às dez horas.
O médico olha a garganta da Ana. Ele diz que ela precisa descansar e beber muita água. Ele lhe dá um remédio para ajudá-la a melhorar. A Ana agradece e sorri.
